source_row.rationale: Electrical burns can cause significant internal tissue damage along the pathway the electrical current traveled through the body (including cardiac arrhythmias, muscle damage/rhabdomyolysis, and nerve damage), which may not be proportionally reflected by the external wound appearance (entry/exit points may look relatively small despite substantial internal injury). This requires careful, broader assessment, including cardiac monitoring, beyond just the visible burn wounds.
source_row.source_detail: Internal Injury Risk Disproportionate to External Appearance
source_row.source_name: American Burn Association — Electrical Burn Injury Assessment
